id-20260922-news-2.title: Suahasil Nazara Tested to Maintain State Budget Health While Chasing 6 Percent Economic Growth Target

segments.src: ## Tugas Berat di Awal Masa Jabatan
segments.tr: ## Heavy Burden at the Beginning of the Term

segments.src: Baru sepekan menjabat sebagai Menteri Keuangan menggantikan Purbaya, Suahasil Nazara langsung dihadapkan pada rentetan pekerjaan rumah yang tidak ringan.
segments.tr: Just a week into his tenure as Minister of Finance replacing Purbaya, Suahasil Nazara was immediately faced with a series of no small homework assignments.

segments.src: Sebagai sosok yang sebelumnya dikenal luas di lingkungan Kementerian Keuangan, ia kini harus membuktikan kemampuannya mengelola isu-isu fiskal strategis dalam waktu yang relatif singkat.
segments.tr: As a figure previously well-known within the Ministry of Finance environment, he now has to prove his ability to manage strategic fiscal issues in a relatively short time.

segments.src: Setidaknya ada tiga agenda besar yang menanti di meja kerjanya: menuntaskan pelaksanaan Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (APBN) 2026, mengawal konsistensi arah kebijakan pada rancangan APBN 2027, serta menjaga kredibilitas fiskal Indonesia di tengah dinamika pasar keuangan yang terus bergerak.
segments.tr: At least three major agendas await on his desk: completing the implementation of the 2026 State Budget (APBN), overseeing the consistency of policy direction in the 2027 State Budget draft, and maintaining Indonesia's fiscal credibility amidst the constantly moving dynamics of the financial market.

segments.src: ## Menjaga Konsistensi Kebijakan Fiskal
segments.tr: ## Maintaining Fiscal Policy Consistency

segments.src: Pergantian pucuk pimpinan di Kementerian Keuangan kerap memunculkan pertanyaan di kalangan pelaku pasar dan investor mengenai arah kebijakan ke depan.
segments.tr: Changes in leadership at the Ministry of Finance often raise questions among market participants and investors regarding future policy directions.

segments.src: Dalam konteks ini, tantangan utama bagi Suahasil bukan hanya soal teknis penganggaran, tetapi juga bagaimana memastikan kesinambungan kebijakan fiskal yang sudah berjalan agar tidak menimbulkan persepsi ketidakpastian.
segments.tr: In this context, the main challenge for Suahasil is not only a matter of budgeting technique, but also how to ensure the continuity of ongoing fiscal policies so as not to cause a perception of uncertainty.

segments.src: Sejumlah pengamat ekonomi menilai transisi kepemimpinan semacam ini wajar terjadi dalam siklus pemerintahan, namun tetap membutuhkan komunikasi yang jelas kepada publik dan pelaku pasar.
segments.tr: A number of economic observers consider such leadership transitions normal in the government cycle, but still require clear communication to the public and market participants.

segments.src: Konsistensi kebijakan dinilai penting agar postur APBN tahun berjalan tetap terjaga, sekaligus memberi sinyal positif bagi persiapan APBN tahun berikutnya.
segments.tr: Policy consistency is considered important so that the posture of the current year's State Budget is maintained, while giving a positive signal for the preparation of the following year's State Budget.

segments.src: ## Menyeimbangkan Kesehatan Fiskal dan Target Pertumbuhan
segments.tr: ## Balancing Fiscal Health and Growth Targets

segments.src: Di sisi lain, pemerintah tetap menargetkan pertumbuhan ekonomi hingga kisaran 6 persen sebagai salah satu tolok ukur keberhasilan pembangunan.
segments.tr: On the other hand, the government still targets economic growth up to the range of 6 percent as one of the benchmarks for development success.

segments.src: Target ambisius ini menuntut ruang fiskal yang cukup untuk mendukung belanja produktif, mulai dari infrastruktur, pendidikan, hingga program-program prioritas lainnya.
segments.tr: This ambitious target demands sufficient fiscal space to support productive spending, ranging from infrastructure, education, to other priority programs.

segments.src: Namun demikian, ruang fiskal yang lebih ekspansif juga membawa konsekuensi terhadap keseimbangan anggaran.
segments.tr: However, more expansive fiscal space also brings consequences to budget balance.

segments.src: Menjaga rasio defisit tetap berada dalam batas aman, mengendalikan biaya pembiayaan utang, serta memastikan penerimaan negara tumbuh sejalan dengan kebutuhan belanja menjadi pekerjaan yang harus dijalankan secara simultan.
segments.tr: Keeping the deficit ratio within safe limits, controlling debt financing costs, and ensuring that state revenues grow in line with spending needs are jobs that must be carried out simultaneously.

segments.src: Para ekonom umumnya sepakat bahwa mengejar pertumbuhan tinggi tanpa mengorbankan kesehatan fiskal bukan perkara mudah.
segments.tr: Economists generally agree that pursuing high growth without sacrificing fiscal health is not an easy matter.

segments.src: Dibutuhkan strategi yang cermat agar stimulus fiskal dapat mendorong roda perekonomian tanpa memicu kekhawatiran berlebihan di pasar surat utang maupun pasar modal.
segments.tr: A careful strategy is needed so that fiscal stimulus can drive the economic wheels without triggering excessive concerns in the debt securities market and capital market.

segments.src: ## Tekanan Pasar dan Kepercayaan Investor
segments.tr: ## Market Pressure and Investor Confidence

segments.src: Kredibilitas fiskal menjadi kata kunci yang terus disorot dalam beberapa waktu terakhir.
segments.tr: Fiscal credibility has become a keyword continuously highlighted in recent times.

segments.src: Investor, baik domestik maupun asing, cenderung mencermati konsistensi kebijakan serta rekam jejak pengelolaan anggaran sebagai salah satu indikator utama sebelum menempatkan dananya di instrumen keuangan Indonesia.
segments.tr: Investors, both domestic and foreign, tend to scrutinize policy consistency and the track record of budget management as one of the main indicators before placing their funds in Indonesia's financial instruments.

segments.src: Dalam situasi pergantian pejabat kunci seperti sekarang, langkah-langkah komunikasi yang transparan dan terukur dari pemerintah dinilai dapat membantu meredam potensi gejolak di pasar.
segments.tr: In a situation of key official changes like now, transparent and measured communication steps from the government are considered to help stem potential turmoil in the market.

segments.src: Sejumlah analis menyarankan agar pemerintah terus memperkuat koordinasi antara kebijakan fiskal dan moneter, sehingga target pertumbuhan ekonomi dapat dicapai tanpa mengorbankan stabilitas makro secara keseluruhan.
segments.tr: A number of analysts suggest that the government continue to strengthen coordination between fiscal and monetary policies, so that economic growth targets can be achieved without sacrificing overall macro stability.

segments.src: ## Harapan ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Future Expectations

segments.src: Publik dan pelaku usaha kini menantikan bagaimana arah kebijakan Suahasil Nazara dalam beberapa bulan ke depan, terutama menjelang pembahasan dan penetapan APBN 2027.
segments.tr: The public and business actors are now awaiting the policy direction of Suahasil Nazara in the coming months, especially ahead of the discussion and stipulation of the 2027 State Budget.

segments.src: Keberhasilan menjaga keseimbangan antara disiplin fiskal dan ambisi pertumbuhan ekonomi akan menjadi ujian penting yang menentukan kepercayaan pasar terhadap arah kebijakan ekonomi nasional ke depan.
segments.tr: The success of maintaining a balance between fiscal discipline and economic growth ambition will be an important test determining market confidence in the future direction of national economic policy.

segments.src: Dengan pengalaman panjang di birokrasi keuangan negara, banyak pihak berharap masa transisi ini dapat berjalan mulus sehingga program-program pembangunan tetap berjalan sesuai rencana, sekaligus menjaga fondasi APBN yang sehat dan berkelanjutan bagi generasi mendatang.
segments.tr: With long experience in state financial bureaucracy, many parties hope this transition period can run smoothly so that development programs continue according to plan, while maintaining a healthy and sustainable State Budget foundation for future generations.

id-20260922-news-1.title: Global Beef Prices Hit Record Highs, A New Threat to Meatball and Rendang Costs in Indonesia

segments.src: ## Pasokan Global Menipis, Harga Melonjak
segments.tr: ## Global Supply Tightens, Prices Surge

segments.src: Harga daging sapi di pasar global dilaporkan bergerak menuju level tertinggi dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, bahkan disebut-sebut menyamai rekor yang pernah tercatat sekitar tahun 2021.
segments.tr: Beef prices in the global market are reportedly moving toward their highest levels in recent years, even said to be matching the records recorded around 2021.

segments.src: Kenaikan ini bukan terjadi tanpa sebab.
segments.tr: This increase did not happen without cause.

segments.src: Dua faktor besar yang saling berkaitan disebut menjadi pemicu utama, yakni menyusutnya populasi sapi di Amerika Serikat dan merebaknya wabah penyakit screwworm (belatung pemakan daging) di Meksiko yang mengganggu jalur perdagangan ternak di kawasan Amerika Utara.
segments.tr: Two major interrelated factors are cited as the main triggers: the shrinking cattle population in the United States and the outbreak of screwworm disease in Mexico, which is disrupting livestock trade routes in the North American region.

segments.src: Amerika Serikat selama ini dikenal sebagai salah satu produsen dan pengekspor daging sapi terbesar di dunia.
segments.tr: The United States has long been known as one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world.

segments.src: Namun dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, jumlah populasi sapi di negara tersebut terus menurun akibat kombinasi kekeringan berkepanjangan, kenaikan biaya pakan ternak, dan keputusan banyak peternak untuk mengurangi jumlah ternaknya karena margin usaha yang semakin tipis.
segments.tr: However, in recent years, the cattle population in the country has continued to decline due to a combination of prolonged drought, rising feed costs, and the decision by many ranchers to reduce their herd sizes because of thinning profit margins.

segments.src: Ketika pasokan berkurang sementara permintaan daging sapi di pasar dunia tetap tinggi, harga pun terdorong naik secara signifikan.
segments.tr: When supply decreases while demand for beef in the world market remains high, prices are pushed up significantly.

segments.src: ## Wabah Screwworm Memperparah Krisis Pasokan
segments.tr: ## Screwworm Outbreak Exacerbates Supply Crisis

segments.src: Di sisi lain, wabah screwworm yang menyebar di sejumlah wilayah Meksiko turut memperburuk situasi.
segments.tr: On the other hand, the screwworm outbreak spreading in several regions of Mexico is further worsening the situation.

segments.src: Parasit ini dikenal berbahaya bagi ternak karena dapat menyebabkan infeksi serius pada hewan yang terluka, sehingga otoritas kesehatan hewan di kawasan tersebut terpaksa memperketat bahkan menghentikan sementara arus perdagangan sapi hidup lintas negara sebagai langkah pencegahan penyebaran penyakit.
segments.tr: This parasite is known to be dangerous to livestock because it can cause serious infections in wounded animals, forcing animal health authorities in the region to tighten or even temporarily halt the flow of cross-border live cattle trade as a measure to prevent the spread of the disease.

segments.src: Pembatasan ini berdampak langsung pada rantai pasok daging sapi regional, khususnya bagi negara-negara yang selama ini bergantung pada impor sapi hidup maupun daging beku dari kawasan Amerika Utara.
segments.tr: This restriction has a direct impact on the regional beef supply chain, especially for countries that have relied on imports of live cattle or frozen meat from the North American region.

segments.src: Ketatnya pasokan di salah satu pusat produksi daging sapi dunia otomatis memberi tekanan tambahan pada harga di pasar internasional, yang pada akhirnya turut memengaruhi harga acuan daging sapi impor secara global, termasuk yang biasa masuk ke pasar Asia.
segments.tr: The tight supply in one of the world's beef production hubs automatically puts additional pressure on prices in the international market, which in turn affects the benchmark price of imported beef globally, including those typically entering the Asian market.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana Dampaknya bagi Indonesia?
segments.tr: ## What Is the Impact on Indonesia?

segments.src: Sebagai negara yang sebagian kebutuhan daging sapinya masih dipenuhi melalui impor, baik dalam bentuk sapi bakalan maupun daging beku, Indonesia berpotensi turut merasakan imbas dari tren kenaikan harga global ini.
segments.tr: As a country that still meets part of its beef needs through imports, both in the form of feeder cattle and frozen meat, Indonesia has the potential to feel the impact of this global price hike trend.

segments.src: Ketika harga acuan di pasar dunia naik, biaya pengadaan daging impor pun cenderung ikut terkerek, yang pada gilirannya dapat memengaruhi harga di tingkat distributor, pasar tradisional, hingga pelaku usaha kuliner di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: When benchmark prices in the world market rise, the cost of procuring imported meat tends to follow, which in turn can affect prices at the distributor level, traditional markets, and even domestic culinary businesses.

segments.src: Kondisi ini patut menjadi perhatian, mengingat daging sapi merupakan bahan baku utama sejumlah kuliner khas yang sangat digemari masyarakat Indonesia, seperti bakso, rendang, sate, hingga soto daging.
segments.tr: This condition deserves attention, considering that beef is a key ingredient for a number of culinary specialties that are very popular among Indonesians, such as meatballs (bakso), rendang, satay, and beef soup (soto daging).

segments.src: Para pelaku usaha kuliner skala kecil dan menengah, termasuk pedagang bakso keliling dan warung rendang, umumnya memiliki ruang gerak yang terbatas untuk menyerap kenaikan biaya bahan baku.
segments.tr: Small and medium-sized culinary business owners, including mobile meatball vendors and rendang stalls, generally have limited room to maneuver to absorb the rise in raw material costs.

segments.src: Jika tren kenaikan harga daging berlanjut, sebagian pelaku usaha mungkin akan menghadapi pilihan sulit antara menaikkan harga jual, mengurangi porsi, atau mencari bahan substitusi.
segments.tr: If the trend of rising meat prices continues, some business owners may face difficult choices between raising selling prices, reducing portions, or looking for substitute ingredients.

segments.src: ## Langkah Antisipasi yang Umum Dilakukan
segments.tr: ## Common Anticipatory Steps

segments.src: Menghadapi dinamika harga komoditas global semacam ini, sejumlah langkah biasanya menjadi opsi yang dipertimbangkan oleh pemangku kepentingan di dalam negeri, di antaranya:
segments.tr: Facing these kinds of global commodity price dynamics, a number of steps are usually considered as options by domestic stakeholders, including:

segments.src: - **Diversifikasi sumber impor**, dengan menjajaki pasokan dari negara produsen daging sapi lain di luar kawasan yang tengah terdampak wabah maupun penurunan populasi ternak.
segments.tr: - **Diversification of import sources**, by exploring supplies from other beef-producing countries outside the regions currently affected by outbreaks or declining livestock populations.

segments.src: - **Penguatan produksi sapi lokal**, melalui program pembibitan dan penggemukan ternak dalam negeri agar ketergantungan pada impor dapat berkurang secara bertahap.
segments.tr: - **Strengthening local cattle production**, through domestic breeding and fattening programs so that dependence on imports can be reduced gradually.

segments.src: - **Substitusi bahan baku pada level usaha kecil**, misalnya kombinasi daging sapi dengan bahan lain pada produk olahan tertentu, tanpa mengurangi standar keamanan pangan.
segments.tr: - **Substitution of raw materials at the small business level**, for example, combining beef with other ingredients in certain processed products, without reducing food safety standards.

segments.src: - **Pemantauan harga secara berkala** oleh otoritas terkait guna menjaga stabilitas pasokan menjelang periode permintaan tinggi seperti hari besar keagamaan maupun akhir tahun.
segments.tr: - **Periodic price monitoring** by relevant authorities to maintain supply stability ahead of high-demand periods such as religious holidays or the end of the year.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Diperhatikan Konsumen
segments.tr: ## What Consumers Need to Pay Attention To

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, tren ini bisa menjadi sinyal untuk lebih bijak dalam mengatur pengeluaran rumah tangga, terutama pada pos belanja bahan pangan berbasis daging.
segments.tr: For the public, this trend could be a signal to be wiser in managing household expenses, especially in the meat-based food shopping category.

segments.src: Memantau perkembangan harga di pasar terdekat, mempertimbangkan alternatif protein lain sebagai variasi menu, serta tidak melakukan pembelian dalam jumlah berlebihan (panic buying) dapat membantu menjaga stabilitas harga di tingkat konsumen.
segments.tr: Monitoring price developments in the nearest market, considering other protein alternatives as menu variations, and not making purchases in excessive amounts (panic buying) can help maintain price stability at the consumer level.

segments.src: Situasi harga daging sapi global ini masih terus berkembang dan sangat bergantung pada bagaimana populasi ternak di negara-negara produsen utama pulih, serta bagaimana penanganan wabah screwworm di kawasan Amerika Utara ke depannya.
segments.tr: This global beef price situation is still evolving and is highly dependent on how livestock populations in major producing countries recover, as well as how the screwworm outbreak in the North American region is handled going forward.

segments.src: Masyarakat dan pelaku usaha di Indonesia disarankan untuk terus mengikuti perkembangan informasi resmi dari sumber terpercaya agar dapat mengambil langkah antisipasi yang tepat.
segments.tr: The public and business owners in Indonesia are advised to continue following official information updates from trusted sources in order to take appropriate anticipatory steps.

id-20260922-news-3.title: KPK Reveals Eight Vulnerable Points of Land Corruption in Greater Jakarta Following ATR/BPN Sting Operation

segments.src: Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK) membuka babak baru pengawasan sektor pertanahan setelah operasi tangkap tangan (OTT) yang menyeret nama pejabat tinggi di lingkungan Kementerian ATR/BPN beserta seorang petinggi perusahaan pengembang properti.
segments.tr: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) has opened a new chapter in the supervision of the land sector following a sting operation (OTT) that implicated high-ranking officials within the Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning/National Land Agency (ATR/BPN) along with an executive from a property development company.

segments.src: Menyusul penindakan tersebut, KPK memetakan sejumlah titik rawan yang selama ini dinilai menjadi celah bagi praktik pungutan liar dan penyalahgunaan wewenang dalam pelayanan pertanahan, khususnya di wilayah Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, dan Bekasi (Jabodetabek).
segments.tr: Following this enforcement action, the KPK has mapped out a number of vulnerable points that have long been considered loopholes for illegal levies and abuse of authority in land services, particularly in the Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, and Bekasi (Jabodetabek) areas.

segments.src: Menurut keterangan yang disampaikan tim KPK, kasus ini masih dalam proses penyidikan lebih lanjut sehingga status hukum para pihak yang diamankan akan ditentukan berdasarkan hasil pemeriksaan dan alat bukti yang sah.
segments.tr: According to statements provided by the KPK team, this case is still in the process of further investigation, so the legal status of the parties secured will be determined based on the results of the examination and valid evidence.

segments.src: KPK menegaskan bahwa langkah OTT merupakan bagian dari upaya penindakan sekaligus pintu masuk untuk melakukan perbaikan sistemik di sektor yang selama bertahun-tahun kerap dikeluhkan masyarakat maupun pelaku usaha.
segments.tr: The KPK emphasized that the OTT step is part of an enforcement effort as well as an entry point to carry out systemic improvements in a sector that has often been complained about by the public and business players for years.

segments.src: ## Delapan Titik Rawan yang Diidentifikasi KPK
segments.tr: ## Eight Vulnerable Points Identified by the KPK

segments.src: Berdasarkan kajian sementara, KPK menyoroti delapan area layanan pertanahan yang berpotensi menjadi ladang penyimpangan apabila tidak diawasi ketat:
segments.tr: Based on a preliminary study, the KPK highlighted eight land service areas that have the potential to become hotbeds for irregularities if not strictly supervised:

segments.src: 1. **Penerbitan sertifikat hak atas tanah baru**, terutama untuk lahan dengan riwayat kepemilikan yang kompleks atau tumpang tindih data.
segments.tr: 1. **Issuance of new land ownership certificates**, especially for land with a complex history of ownership or overlapping data.

segments.src: 2. **Proses balik nama sertifikat**, yang kerap memakan waktu lama sehingga membuka ruang bagi praktik percaloan.
segments.tr: 2. **Certificate name transfer process**, which often takes a long time, thus opening space for brokerage practices.

segments.src: 3. **Pemecahan dan penggabungan bidang tanah (splitsing)**, khususnya untuk kawasan yang tengah berkembang pesat menjadi area komersial dan permukiman baru.
segments.tr: 3. **Splitting and merging of land plots (splitsing)**, especially for areas that are developing rapidly into new commercial and residential areas.

segments.src: 4. **Pengukuran ulang dan pemetaan bidang tanah**, di mana ketidaksesuaian data lapangan disebut sering dimanfaatkan oknum tertentu.
segments.tr: 4. **Re-measurement and mapping of land plots**, where discrepancies in field data are said to be often exploited by certain individuals.

segments.src: 5. **Penerbitan izin lokasi dan rekomendasi alih fungsi lahan**, yang menjadi krusial bagi proyek properti skala besar di kawasan penyangga ibu kota.
segments.tr: 5. **Issuance of location permits and land conversion recommendations**, which are crucial for large-scale property projects in the capital's buffer zones.

segments.src: 6. **Penerbitan surat keterangan bebas sengketa**, yang dibutuhkan sebagai syarat berbagai transaksi jual-beli maupun agunan.
segments.tr: 6. **Issuance of certificates of no dispute**, which are required as a condition for various buying and selling transactions as well as collateral.

segments.src: 7. **Perpanjangan dan pembaruan Hak Guna Bangunan (HGB)** untuk proyek-proyek komersial dan perumahan berskala besar.
segments.tr: 7. **Extension and renewal of Building Use Rights (HGB)** for large-scale commercial and residential projects.

segments.src: 8. **Layanan informasi dan verifikasi data pertanahan** yang menjadi rujukan notaris, pengembang, maupun masyarakat umum sebelum transaksi dilakukan.
segments.tr: 8. **Land data information and verification services** which serve as a reference for notaries, developers, and the general public before transactions are carried out.

segments.src: KPK menyebut kedelapan titik tersebut rawan disalahgunakan karena melibatkan proses administrasi yang panjang, kewenangan diskresi pejabat yang cukup besar, serta nilai ekonomi transaksi tanah di kawasan Jabodetabek yang terus meningkat seiring pesatnya pembangunan properti.
segments.tr: The KPK stated that these eight points are prone to abuse because they involve long administrative processes, significant discretionary authority of officials, and the economic value of land transactions in the Jabodetabek area which continues to increase along with rapid property development.

segments.src: ## Layanan Lambat Dinilai Jadi Pemicu
segments.tr: ## Slow Services Considered a Trigger

segments.src: Selain pola pungutan liar, KPK juga menyoroti lambannya birokrasi di sejumlah kantor pertanahan wilayah sebagai faktor yang turut membuka peluang penyimpangan.
segments.tr: In addition to the pattern of illegal levies, the KPK also highlighted the slow bureaucracy in a number of regional land offices as a factor that also opens up opportunities for irregularities.

segments.src: Ketika proses resmi dianggap berbelit dan memakan waktu tidak pasti, sebagian pemohon disebut memilih menempuh "jalur cepat" yang justru rentan disusupi praktik tidak sah.
segments.tr: When official processes are considered convoluted and time-consuming, some applicants are said to choose to take the "fast track" which is actually vulnerable to being infiltrated by illegal practices.

segments.src: Kondisi ini, menurut KPK, perlu menjadi perhatian serius agar reformasi birokrasi pertanahan tidak berhenti sebagai wacana.
segments.tr: This condition, according to the KPK, needs to be a serious concern so that land bureaucratic reform does not stop as mere discourse.

segments.src: ## Rekomendasi Perbaikan
segments.tr: ## Improvement Recommendations

segments.src: Sebagai tindak lanjut, KPK mendorong beberapa langkah perbaikan, di antaranya:
segments.tr: As a follow-up, the KPK is pushing for several improvement steps, including:

segments.src: - Digitalisasi menyeluruh layanan pertanahan agar proses lebih transparan dan dapat dipantau publik secara real-time.
segments.tr: - Comprehensive digitalization of land services so that processes are more transparent and can be monitored by the public in real-time.

segments.src: - Penguatan sistem pengaduan masyarakat yang terintegrasi dengan pengawasan internal Kementerian ATR/BPN.
segments.tr: - Strengthening the public complaint system that is integrated with the internal supervision of the Ministry of ATR/BPN.

segments.src: - Audit berkala terhadap kantor-kantor pertanahan dengan volume transaksi tinggi, khususnya di kawasan berkembang seperti Jabodetabek.
segments.tr: - Periodic audits of land offices with high transaction volumes, especially in developing areas such as Jabodetabek.

segments.src: - Pembatasan diskresi pejabat dalam proses yang berpotensi menimbulkan konflik kepentingan, terutama pada perizinan alih fungsi lahan skala besar.
segments.tr: - Limitation of official discretion in processes that have the potential to cause conflicts of interest, especially in large-scale land conversion permits.

segments.src: Kementerian ATR/BPN sendiri menyatakan akan bekerja sama penuh dengan proses hukum yang berjalan dan mendukung rekomendasi perbaikan tata kelola yang disampaikan KPK.
segments.tr: The Ministry of ATR/BPN itself stated that it will cooperate fully with the ongoing legal process and support the governance improvement recommendations submitted by the KPK.

segments.src: Pihak berwenang mengimbau masyarakat untuk tetap menggunakan jalur resmi dalam mengurus dokumen pertanahan serta segera melaporkan apabila menemukan indikasi pungutan di luar ketentuan resmi.
segments.tr: The authorities urge the public to continue using official channels in managing land documents and to immediately report if they find indications of levies outside official provisions.

segments.src: Kasus ini menjadi pengingat bahwa sektor pertanahan, dengan nilai ekonomi yang terus tumbuh seiring ekspansi kawasan urban di sekitar Jakarta, membutuhkan pengawasan berlapis agar pelayanan publik berjalan adil, cepat, dan bebas dari praktik koruptif.
segments.tr: This case serves as a reminder that the land sector, with its economic value continuing to grow along with the expansion of urban areas around Jakarta, requires layered supervision so that public services run fairly, quickly, and free from corrupt practices.

id-20260922-intro-retail-4.title: [Retail #4] Why Is Instant Noodles More Expensive at Minimarkets? That's the Real Work of Retail Business

segments.src: > Ritel adalah mata rantai terakhir yang memecah tumpukan barang pabrik menjadi satu bungkus yang pas untuk Anda — dan selisih harganya sebenarnya adalah ongkos jasa itu.
segments.tr: > Retail is the last link in the chain that breaks down factory bulk into individual packages just right for you — and the price difference is actually the cost of that service.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: ### Apa itu ritel?
segments.tr: ### What is retail?

segments.src: **Ritel** (*retail*, eceran) adalah kegiatan menjual barang atau jasa **langsung kepada konsumen akhir** untuk **dipakai sendiri**, bukan untuk dijual lagi.
segments.tr: **Retail** (*retail*) is the activity of selling goods or services **directly to end consumers** for **their own use**, not for resale.

segments.src: Dua kata kunci itu yang membedakannya dari **grosir** (*wholesale*), yang menjual kepada pihak yang akan menjual ulang atau mengolahnya.
segments.tr: Those two key features distinguish it from **wholesale**, which sells to parties that will resell or process it.

segments.src: Bedanya ada pada *siapa pembelinya*, bukan pada besar-kecilnya toko.
segments.tr: The difference is in *who the buyer is*, not the size of the store.

segments.src: Satu toko bangunan bisa menjalankan keduanya: menjual lima sak semen ke bapak yang memperbaiki dapur rumahnya (ritel) dan 500 sak ke kontraktor perumahan (grosir).
segments.tr: A single building supply store can do both: selling five bags of cement to a homeowner fixing their kitchen (retail) and 500 bags to a housing contractor (wholesale).

segments.src: Ritel juga tidak identik dengan toko fisik.
segments.tr: Retail is also not identical to a physical store.

segments.src: Warung di gang, Indomaret di ujung jalan, lapak di Tokopedia, penjual yang siaran langsung di TikTok, pedagang sayur keliling, bahkan bioskop, salon, dan klinik gigi — semuanya ritel, karena melayani konsumen akhir.
segments.tr: A shop in an alley, an Indomaret at the corner, a stall on Tokopedia, a seller doing live streaming on TikTok, a street vegetable vendor, even a cinema, salon, and dental clinic — all of these are retail, because they serve end consumers.

segments.src: ### Lima peran ritel
segments.tr: ### Five roles of retail

segments.src: Margin ritel sering dianggap "harga yang di-mark-up".
segments.tr: Retail margins are often seen as just "marked-up prices".

segments.src: Sebenarnya itu bayaran untuk lima pekerjaan berikut:
segments.tr: Actually, that's payment for five jobs:

segments.src: 1. **Memecah partai besar** (*bulk breaking*) — pabrik memproduksi per truk, Anda butuh per bungkus. Ritel yang memecahnya.
segments.tr: 1. **Breaking bulk** (*bulk breaking*) — factories produce by the truckload, but you need individual packages. Retail breaks it down.

segments.src: 2. **Menyediakan keragaman** (*assortment*) — Anda bisa membeli sabun, pulsa, dan roti dari ratusan merek di satu tempat, tanpa mendatangi ratusan pabrik.
segments.tr: 2. **Providing variety** (*assortment*) — you can buy soap, phone credit, and bread from hundreds of brands in one place, without visiting hundreds of factories.

segments.src: 3. **Menyimpan stok dan menanggung risiko** — barang yang tidak laku, rusak, atau kedaluwarsa menjadi kerugian peritel, bukan kerugian Anda.
segments.tr: 3. **Holding inventory and bearing risk** — unsold, damaged, or expired goods become the retailer's loss, not yours.

segments.src: 4. **Mendekatkan tempat dan waktu** — buka 24 jam, berjarak 200 meter dari rumah, diantar dalam 30 menit. Nilai ini nyata, meski tidak terlihat di label harga.
segments.tr: 4. **Bringing place and time closer** — open 24 hours, 200 meters from home, delivered in 30 minutes. This value is real, even if it doesn't show on the price tag.

segments.src: 5. **Menjadi jembatan informasi dua arah** — data kasir memberi tahu produsen apa yang laku; rak, label, dan pramuniaga memberi tahu Anda apa yang tersedia.
segments.tr: 5. **Being a two-way information bridge** — cash register data tells producers what sells; shelves, labels, and staff tell you what's available.

segments.src: ### Dari pasar ke layar: perjalanan singkat ritel
segments.tr: ### From market to screen: retail's short journey

segments.src: - **Barter dan pasar tradisional** — bentuk paling tua; harga ditentukan lewat tawar-menawar.
segments.tr: - **Barter and traditional markets** — the oldest form; prices determined through haggling.

segments.src: - **Toko kelontong dan warung** — pedagang menetap dengan pelanggan tetap dan sistem "kasbon".
segments.tr: - **General stores and neighborhood shops** — fixed merchants with regular customers and a "credit" system.

segments.src: - **Department store** — dimulai dari Bon Marché di Paris (1852): harga pas, boleh melihat-lihat tanpa wajib membeli. Di Indonesia, Matahari berawal dari sebuah toko pakaian anak di Pasar Baru, Jakarta (1958), dan Sarinah berdiri sebagai pusat perbelanjaan modern pertama pada era 1960-an.
segments.tr: - **Department store** — starting with Bon Marché in Paris (1852): fixed prices, customers can browse without obligation to buy. In Indonesia, Matahari began as a children's clothing store in Pasar Baru, Jakarta (1958), and Sarinah became the first modern shopping center in the 1960s.

segments.src: - **Swalayan dan supermarket** — Piggly Wiggly di Amerika Serikat (1916) memperkenalkan konsep *self-service*: konsumen mengambil sendiri barang dari rak. Hero Supermarket (1971) menjadi salah satu perintisnya di Indonesia.
segments.tr: - **Self-service stores and supermarkets** — Piggly Wiggly in the United States (1916) introduced the *self-service* concept: customers pick items themselves from shelves. Hero Supermarket (1971) became one of its pioneers in Indonesia.

segments.src: - **Hypermarket dan minimarket berjaringan** — Indomaret membuka gerai pertamanya pada 1988, Alfamart menyusul dengan format minimarket pada akhir 1990-an, dan Carrefour masuk Indonesia pada 1998. Kunci mereka: skala pembelian dan sistem distribusi, bukan sekadar bangunan toko.
segments.tr: - **Hypermarkets and chain minimarkets** — Indomaret opened its first outlet in 1988, Alfamart followed with a minimarket format in the late 1990s, and Carrefour entered Indonesia in 1998. Their key: purchasing scale and distribution systems, not just the building.

segments.src: - **E-commerce dan omnichannel** — Tokopedia (2009) dan Shopee (2015) memindahkan etalase ke layar ponsel. Kini batas antar-kanal makin kabur: *live shopping*, belanja daring lalu ambil di gerai, dan pengiriman cepat dalam hitungan menit.
segments.tr: - **E-commerce and omnichannel** — Tokopedia (2009) and Shopee (2015) moved storefronts to mobile screens. Now the lines between channels blur: *live shopping*, order online and pick up at stores, and delivery in minutes.

segments.src: Polanya konsisten: setiap lompatan terjadi ketika **teknologi baru menurunkan biaya melayani konsumen akhir** — kereta api, lemari pendingin, barcode, lalu ponsel pintar.
segments.tr: The pattern is consistent: each leap happens when **new technology lowers the cost of serving end consumers** — railways, refrigerators, barcodes, then smartphones.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bu Ratna tinggal di Bekasi.
segments.tr: Bu Ratna lives in Bekasi.

segments.src: Pukul 21.30, anaknya minta mi instan.
segments.tr: At 21:30, her child wants instant noodles.

segments.src: Kalau ia mau harga termurah, ia bisa ke toko grosir di dekat pasar dan membeli **satu karton isi 40 bungkus**, misalnya seharga Rp120.000 — sekitar Rp3.000 per bungkus.
segments.tr: If she wanted the cheapest price, she could go to a wholesale store near the market and buy **one carton with 40 packages**, for example at Rp120,000 — about Rp3,000 per package.

segments.src: Tapi toko itu sudah tutup, jaraknya 3 km, dan ia hanya butuh dua bungkus malam ini.
segments.tr: But that store is closed, it's 3 km away, and she only needs two packages tonight.

segments.src: Maka ia berjalan 200 meter ke minimarket dan membayar, misalnya, Rp3.700 per bungkus.
segments.tr: So she walks 200 meters to the minimarket and pays, for example, Rp3,700 per package.

segments.src: Selisih Rp700 itu bukan "kemahalan" begitu saja.
segments.tr: That Rp700 difference isn't just "overpricing".

segments.src: Di dalamnya ada: pemecahan karton menjadi satuan, sewa gerai di dekat rumahnya, listrik dan pegawai jam 21.30, serta stok yang harus tersedia meski belum tentu laku.
segments.tr: Inside it: breaking down cartons into units, rent for a store near her home, electricity and staff at 21:30, plus inventory that must be available even if it might not sell.

segments.src: Besok paginya, ia memesan deterjen ukuran besar lewat aplikasi karena ada gratis ongkir dan harganya lebih murah — barangnya tidak mendesak, jadi ia bersedia menunggu dua hari.
segments.tr: The next morning, she orders large-size detergent through an app because shipping is free and the price is lower — the item is not urgent, so she's willing to wait two days.

segments.src: Peritel yang berbeda, keputusan yang berbeda, tapi fungsi ekonominya sama persis: **menjembatani produsen dan konsumen akhir**.
segments.tr: Different retailer, different choice, but the economic function is exactly the same: **connecting producers and end consumers**.

segments.src: Yang dibeli Bu Ratna sepanjang hari itu bukan hanya mi dan deterjen, melainkan juga kedekatan, waktu, dan kepastian stok.
segments.tr: What Bu Ratna bought throughout that day wasn't just noodles and detergent, but also proximity, time, and stock certainty.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Ritel = menjual barang/jasa kepada **konsumen akhir untuk dipakai sendiri**; grosir menjual kepada pihak yang akan menjual atau mengolah lagi.
segments.tr: 1. Retail = selling goods/services to **end consumers for their own use**; wholesale sells to parties that will resell or process them.

segments.src: 2. Peran intinya ada lima: memecah partai besar, menyediakan keragaman, menyimpan stok dan risiko, mendekatkan tempat-waktu, serta menyalurkan informasi dua arah — dan margin adalah bayaran untuk itu.
segments.tr: 2. Its five core roles are: breaking bulk, providing variety, holding inventory and risk, bringing place and time closer, and channeling two-way information — and the margin is payment for these.

segments.src: 3. Sejarahnya bergerak dari pasar tradisional → department store → swalayan → minimarket/hypermarket → e-commerce dan omnichannel, selalu didorong teknologi yang menurunkan biaya melayani konsumen akhir.
segments.tr: 3. Its history progresses from traditional market → department store → self-service store → minimarket/hypermarket → e-commerce and omnichannel, always driven by technology that lowers the cost of serving end consumers.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Check Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Manakah yang **BUKAN** termasuk kegiatan ritel?
segments.tr: **1.** Which is **NOT** a retail activity?

segments.src: - (A) Warung menjual dua bungkus kopi sachet kepada tetangga
segments.tr: - (A) A shop selling two packets of instant coffee to a neighbor

segments.src: - (B) Distributor menjual 50 karton sabun kepada pemilik toko kelontong
segments.tr: - (B) A distributor selling 50 cartons of soap to a general store owner

segments.src: - (C) Klinik gigi melayani pasien yang datang sendiri
segments.tr: - (C) A dental clinic serving patients who come in

segments.src: - (D) Penjual di TikTok menjual kaus lewat siaran langsung kepada penonton
segments.tr: - (D) A TikTok seller selling t-shirts through live streaming to viewers

segments.src: **2.** (Benar/Salah) Karena harganya lebih mahal per satuan, minimarket sebenarnya tidak memberi nilai tambah apa pun dibanding toko grosir.
segments.tr: **2.** (True/False) Because the per-unit price is higher, minimarkets actually add no value compared to wholesale stores.

segments.src: **3.** Urutan kemunculan format ritel yang paling tepat adalah…
segments.tr: **3.** The most accurate order of retail format emergence is…

segments.tr: - (A) Self-service supermarket → traditional market → e-commerce → department store

segments.tr: - (B) Traditional market → department store → self-service supermarket → e-commerce

segments.src: - (C) Department store → pasar tradisional → e-commerce → supermarket swalayan
segments.tr: - (C) Department store → traditional market → e-commerce → self-service supermarket

segments.src: - (D) E-commerce → supermarket swalayan → department store → pasar tradisional
segments.tr: - (D) E-commerce → self-service supermarket → department store → traditional market

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Ritel (*retail*)** — penjualan barang/jasa kepada konsumen akhir untuk dipakai sendiri, bukan dijual kembali.
segments.tr: - **Retail (*retail*)** — the sale of goods/services to end consumers for their own use, not for resale.

segments.src: - **Grosir (*wholesale*)** — penjualan kepada pihak yang akan menjual ulang, menyewakan, atau mengolah barang tersebut.
segments.tr: - **Wholesale (*wholesale*)** — the sale to parties that will resell, lease, or process the goods.

segments.src: - **Memecah partai besar (*bulk breaking*)** — mengubah kemasan besar dari produsen menjadi satuan kecil yang sesuai kebutuhan konsumen.
segments.tr: - **Bulk breaking (*bulk breaking*)** — converting large packaging from producers into small units suited to consumer needs.

segments.src: - **Keragaman produk (*assortment*)** — kombinasi jenis dan variasi barang yang disediakan satu peritel agar konsumen bisa berbelanja di satu tempat.
segments.tr: - **Product assortment (*assortment*)** — the combination of types and varieties of goods that one retailer offers so consumers can shop in one place.

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — strategi menyatukan gerai fisik, aplikasi, dan marketplace sebagai satu pengalaman belanja bagi konsumen yang sama.
segments.tr: - **Omnichannel** — a strategy of uniting physical stores, apps, and marketplaces as one shopping experience for the same consumers.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) B — pembelinya adalah pemilik toko yang akan menjual ulang, jadi itu grosir, bukan ritel; ukuran transaksi bukan penentunya.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) B — the buyer is a store owner who will resell, so that's wholesale, not retail; transaction size is not the determining factor.

segments.src: 2) Salah — selisih harga adalah bayaran atas jasa memecah kemasan, kedekatan lokasi, jam buka panjang, dan risiko stok yang ditanggung peritel.
segments.tr: 2) False — the price difference is payment for packaging-breaking services, location proximity, extended hours, and inventory risk borne by the retailer.

segments.src: 3) B — pasar tradisional (paling tua) → department store (abad ke-19) → swalayan/supermarket (abad ke-20) → e-commerce (era internet).*
segments.tr: 3) B — traditional market (oldest) → department store (19th century) → self-service store/supermarket (20th century) → e-commerce (internet era).*
